definition.induction: First governed contact with a proposal, completed by literal preservation and queue registration before any review, interpretation, normalization, classification, or promotion decision.

required_intake_operations: Copy the exact source bytes into the governed induction queue.
Create a queue entry referencing the preserved source path and hash.
Hash the queued copy and verify exact equality.
Mark preservation_status as INDUCTED only after verification.
Do not review, summarize, normalize, reject, hold, or promote as part of this induction operation.
success_condition: The complete original proposal exists in the governed induction queue as a recoverable, byte-identical artifact.
failure_condition: Any absence, mutation, summary substitution, hash mismatch, or unregistered source means induction failed.
